compat_notes: Plain static files at repo root; native ES modules require HTTP serving, which static hosting satisfies. No SPA routing; share links use ?arch= on the same page.
caveats: Whole repo root is served (README, docs/, tests/, package.json publicly reachable). Runtime fetches Tailwind Play CDN and Three.js from cdnjs. Share-PNG watermark text and og:url meta point to the upstream GitHub Pages URL (fork owners may want to change them). Saves, campaign progress and settings live in localStorage, per origin, so they do not carry over from pshenok.github.io. No analytics tags, forms, auth, payments or secrets found. No base path or site URL config.
policy: Read CONTRIBUTING.md (fork, branch, open PR against main; no issue-first rule; MIT), README (Getting Started explicitly covers running 'your own copy — a fork'), .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE (bug/feature), .github/FUNDING.yml, CI workflow. No AGENTS.md, AI policy, CLA or PR template. why: The README already tells people to run their own copy of a fork and explains it must be served over HTTP, not file://. The game is free, no-build static ES modules, so a fork with custom campaign levels, balance or translations (e.g. for a class or workshop) can be put online as-is, and its ?arch= share links then point at that fork's own URL.
